about: Crowd clip library for build_mpfb_character.py --mocap DIR. Times are seconds into each source file. Every clip is retargeted to the character, resampled to the library fps (15; the game interpolates) and loop-blended. Sources are Rokoko free mocap (VOID_RUNNER_KEEP); they are never modified. Clips with "source": "ual" come from Quaternius Universal Animation Library (CC0), UAL1_Standard.glb, given as --ual DIR; their bind pose is not a T-pose, so restAction names the T-pose clip used as reference. Clips with "source": "mixamo" are Mixamo animations the owner downloaded (Adobe Mixamo licence: free for use in games, baked onto our characters, never redistributed as raw files), given as --mixamo DIR (the downloaded FBX files, and the needed files extracted from his Mixamo pack ZIPs).
